notes.title: Our third title "Kargast" is now available on all platforms!
A new title! Also, join our discord community!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We're happy to announce that we've started developing a new thriller & adventure game. We hope to put all that we've learned through our development journey into it and present it to you! ːmanFː ːwomanFː

More details will be revealed about it soon, in the meantime, we'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback on our fresh Discord channel where we'll also hold giveaways for our Steam games, including the upcoming one!

Discord : https://discord.gg/YgsmH44

Twitter : https://twitter.com/frymoregames
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/frymoregames/
